title: B3.4 Retire AUTH_MODE=access_code; loopback-only insecure settings
description: From the external review R07 (Codex stt-external-review pass 1, accepted by the lead). The module is not in production and nobody runs it, and the README already schedules access_code for removal. Since B3.1 the stub provides SSO, so tests no longer need it. access_code bypasses the expected-user checks and forwards service-key-only credentials (module_auth.py about :677, :709). Remove AUTH_MODE, APP_ACCESS_CODE, DEMO_SPACE_ID if it is only for it, the access-code login route and form, and its tests; move every test and gate state that signs in with it onto the stub's SSO. Then: COOKIE_SECURE=false and http public URLs (MODULE_PUBLIC_URL, ENEO_PUBLIC_URL) are accepted only for an exactly parsed loopback host (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1); otherwise the start refuses with a clear message. ENEO_BACKEND_URL over http on the service network stays allowed. No production-mode flag. Tests first. Docs: backend.md, auth-and-session.md, operations.md.

title: Bump next past GHSA-vcvr-r3jv-pc5j so the CI audit step passes
description:


title: Phase 3: the flow page's frame and setup
description:
## Read first
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-astryx-port-plan.md`: "Global Constraints" and "How to work" (every time), then **"Phases 2–7 — Surface cards": the kickoff, and the Phase 3 card**.
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-platform-design.md`: decision D10 (widget swaps) and D6 (dialogs and the signed-out cover).
- `AGENTS.md` in the repository root, once Phase 0.4 has created it.

## Scope
Branch `feat/astryx-phase-3` from `feat/astryx` (merge `main` into `feat/astryx` first).

Files you may change, and no others in `app/` or `components/`:
- `frontend/components/flow/FlowTopBar.tsx`, `FlowRunPage.tsx`, `FlowAside.tsx`, `FlowPageStates.tsx`, `StateCard.tsx`, `BackToFlows.tsx`
- `frontend/components/flow/FlowInput.tsx`, `ModeCards.tsx`, `DetailsForm.tsx`, `ParticipantsInput.tsx`, `MicrophoneCheck.tsx`, `UploadPanel.tsx`, `ClassificationNote.tsx`, `EarlierRuns.tsx`
- `frontend/components/frame.tsx`, `frontend/components/AppHeader.tsx` (delete `LegacyAppHeader`)
Plus: `frontend/tests/legacy-ui-files.json` (remove ported files, never add), the unit tests the card names (selectors
and class assertions only), the ARIA snapshots of this phase's states, `frontend/kit/theme/eneo.theme.ts` for a
design-system shortfall (then `npm run theme:build`).

## Out of scope
- `app/flows/[id]/page.tsx`'s run logic and `components/flow/useFlowSession.ts`. Only the views' markup changes.
- Recording, live and ready views (Phase 4), even though they share the page.
- `backend/` and everything under `frontend/lib/` except the test files named in Scope.
- Screens and components that belong to another bead.
- Gate thresholds, gate states, axe exclusions, and the Astryx versions (exact pins).
- Ejecting ("swizzling") an Astryx component, authoring StyleX, adding Tailwind classes.
- Plan B (removing Next.js) and Plan C (the module kit).
- If something outside this scope looks wrong, write a comment on this bead (`br comments add`) and leave it alone.

## Steps
1. Kickoff, before any code: run this phase's gate states and unit tests (they must pass), run the loop in "How to
   work" for each screen, and write this phase's task list in the form of Phase 1's tasks (files, mapping table,
   behaviour to keep with the test that proves it, coupled tests, snapshots). Post it as a comment on this bead and
   get it reviewed before porting.
2. Port screen by screen following the card (frame: `ModuleShell` whose heading and end content the flow page decides; setup form on Astryx fields). One commit per screen.
3. For each "widget swap to try" in the card: apply the rule in "Widget swaps". Record which path was taken.
4. Run the phase exit: lint, unit tests, build, this phase's gate states in all 19 projects, `test:prod`, screenshots and the page-cost table. Do not run the whole gate: the lead runs it after the merge.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Gate states pass in all 19 projects: `setup`, `setup-participants`, `setup-microphone-check`, `setup-count-from-names`, `setup-count-invalid`, `upload-chosen-file`, `setup-required-detail`, `setup-own-count-invalid`, `setup-republished`, `unsent-on-setup`, `flow-gone`, `flow-republish-required`.
- `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass; the gate states listed above pass in all 19 projects (`npm run test:a11y -- -g "<state>"` per state, on this worktree's own ports); `npm run test:prod` passes. The whole gate runs once, by the lead, after the phases are merged.
- `tests/e2e/session-cover.spec.ts` passes.
- Every file in Scope is off `tests/legacy-ui-files.json`: no string-literal `className`, no old imports.
- ARIA snapshots changed only for this phase's states, after reading the diff.
- Everything listed under "Keep" in the card still works, proved by the tests the card names.
- `locked` shows no way off the page; `trailing` replaces the account menu; links ask the leave question.
- The input modes are one tab stop moved by arrow keys (two `keyboard.spec.ts` tests).
- The docked primary action on phones stays in the main region and never covers the focused control.
- The pull request into `feat/astryx` lists theme corrections, changed test expectations and widget-swap outcomes,
  with screenshots at phone-320-light, phone-390-dark, laptop-1440-light and ultrawide-3440-light.

## Verify
```bash
cd frontend
npm run lint && npm test
npm run test:a11y -- -g "<state>"          # each state of this phase
npm run build && npm run test:prod   # plus the states above, with A11Y_APP_PORT/A11Y_STUB_PORT set to this phase's own pair
```

## If blocked
Stop and comment on this bead instead of working around it when: a step's expected result does not appear after
one honest attempt to fix the cause; a stop condition in the plan ("Stop conditions") holds; or the task seems to
need a change outside Scope.
close_reason: Merged into feat/astryx (final tip b9f6e9e, pushed). Final whole 19-project gate on b9f6e9e: 1842 passed, 0 failed. Branding gate 88+37, review gate 2, test:prod 9 passed (budgets 2433184), docker build OK, 808 units, lint clean, backend 249 OK. The phase's states are in the gate and pass in all 19 projects; session-cover passes; its files are off the legacy list (the list is deleted in Phase 8, with legacy-ui.test.ts as the guard).

title: Phase 4: recording, live text, ready
description:
## Read first
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-astryx-port-plan.md`: "Global Constraints" and "How to work" (every time), then **"Phases 2–7 — Surface cards": the kickoff, and the Phase 4 card**.
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-platform-design.md`: decision D10 (widget swaps) and D6 (dialogs and the signed-out cover).
- `AGENTS.md` in the repository root, once Phase 0.4 has created it.

## Scope
Branch `feat/astryx-phase-4` from `feat/astryx` (merge `main` into `feat/astryx` first).

Files you may change, and no others in `app/` or `components/`:
- `frontend/components/flow/Recorder.tsx`, `LevelMeter.tsx`, `LiveSheet.tsx`, `ReadyPanel.tsx`, `AudioPlayer.tsx` and their new `*.module.css`
- `frontend/app/globals.css`: move the `lyssna-*` animations out, add `--module-color-record`
- `frontend/tests/e2e/checks.ts`: the slider-track lookup only, with a new case in `harness.spec.ts`
Plus: `frontend/tests/legacy-ui-files.json` (remove ported files, never add), the unit tests the card names (selectors
and class assertions only), the ARIA snapshots of this phase's states, `frontend/kit/theme/eneo.theme.ts` for a
design-system shortfall (then `npm run theme:build`).

## Out of scope
- `lib/recording-session.ts`, `lib/recording-store.ts`, `lib/microphone.ts`, `lib/live-transcriber.ts`, `lib/pcm.ts`, `components/flow/live-audio.ts`, `recording-hooks.ts`: recording behaviour is not touched.
- `backend/` and everything under `frontend/lib/` except the test files named in Scope.
- Screens and components that belong to another bead.
- Gate thresholds, gate states, axe exclusions, and the Astryx versions (exact pins).
- Ejecting ("swizzling") an Astryx component, authoring StyleX, adding Tailwind classes.
- Plan B (removing Next.js) and Plan C (the module kit).
- If something outside this scope looks wrong, write a comment on this bead (`br comments add`) and leave it alone.

## Steps
1. Kickoff, before any code: run this phase's gate states and unit tests (they must pass), run the loop in "How to
   work" for each screen, and write this phase's task list in the form of Phase 1's tasks (files, mapping table,
   behaviour to keep with the test that proves it, coupled tests, snapshots). Post it as a comment on this bead and
   get it reviewed before porting.
2. Port screen by screen following the card (bespoke surfaces allowed a CSS Module: `LevelMeter`, the pulse and blink, the docked recording bar). One commit per screen.
3. For each "widget swap to try" in the card: apply the rule in "Widget swaps". Record which path was taken.
4. Run the phase exit: lint, unit tests, build, this phase's gate states in all 19 projects, `test:prod`, screenshots and the page-cost table. Do not run the whole gate: the lead runs it after the merge.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Gate states pass in all 19 projects: `recording`, `recording-paused`, `recording-details-open`, `stromma`, `ready`, `ready-delete-dialog`, `time-left-15`, `time-left-5`, `too-long-for-one-file`, `silent-microphone`, `disk-full`, `microphone-muted`, `signed-out-recording`.
- `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass; the gate states listed above pass in all 19 projects (`npm run test:a11y -- -g "<state>"` per state, on this worktree's own ports); `npm run test:prod` passes. The whole gate runs once, by the lead, after the phases are merged.
- `tests/e2e/session-cover.spec.ts` passes.
- Every file in Scope is off `tests/legacy-ui-files.json`: no string-literal `className`, no old imports.
- ARIA snapshots changed only for this phase's states, after reading the diff.
- Everything listed under "Keep" in the card still works, proved by the tests the card names.
- Pausa and Stoppa ignore a second tap for 700 ms; the live region says each status once and never the timer.
- The recording's controls move into the sign-in dialog when the login ends.
- Pulse and blink stop under reduced motion.
- The pull request into `feat/astryx` lists theme corrections, changed test expectations and widget-swap outcomes,
  with screenshots at phone-320-light, phone-390-dark, laptop-1440-light and ultrawide-3440-light.

## Verify
```bash
cd frontend
npm run lint && npm test
npm run test:a11y -- -g "<state>"          # each state of this phase
npm run build && npm run test:prod   # plus the states above, with A11Y_APP_PORT/A11Y_STUB_PORT set to this phase's own pair
```

## If blocked
Stop and comment on this bead instead of working around it when: a step's expected result does not appear after
one honest attempt to fix the cause; a stop condition in the plan ("Stop conditions") holds; or the task seems to
need a change outside Scope.
close_reason: Merged into feat/astryx (final tip b9f6e9e, pushed). Final whole 19-project gate on b9f6e9e: 1842 passed, 0 failed. Branding gate 88+37, review gate 2, test:prod 9 passed (budgets 2433184), docker build OK, 808 units, lint clean, backend 249 OK. The phase's states are in the gate and pass in all 19 projects; session-cover passes; its files are off the legacy list (the list is deleted in Phase 8, with legacy-ui.test.ts as the guard).

comments.text:
# Phase 4 kickoff: recording, live text, ready By sonnet-kickoff4. Read-only: nothing was built, started or run. "Run this phase's states and unit tests first" is step 0 of the port, in the phase worktree. Tree read: `feat/astryx-foundation` at 9419653. Every Astryx prop below comes from `npm run astryx -- component ` (0.6.3). Where the doc table is silent I read `node_modules/@astryxdesign/core/src` and cite file:line. Labels: **direct** = Astryx component with props; **widget swap to try** = the plan's Widget swaps rule; **keep custom** = bespoke markup or kept logic, with Astryx controls and tokens. ## 0. What in the card is wrong, missing or contradicts the code 1. **Pulse and blink do not exist.** `lyssna-pulse-ring` and `lyssna-blink` are defined in `app/globals.css:160-185`, silenced at `:239`, and used by no component. Their only user (`AudioRecorder.tsx`) was deleted in 34f5a66 (`git show 34f5a66 | grep lyssna`). Today the recording dot is static (`Recorder.tsx:26`). "Move them into Recorder.module.css" and the acceptance line "Pulse and blink stop under reduced motion" have nothing to act on. Proposal (D1): delete the dead rules (`globals.css:160-185` and the `.lyssna-*` line at `:239`), add no looping animation (WCAG 2.2.2 would need a pause control), and read the acceptance line as: the `reduced-motion` project finds no endless animation (`a11y.spec.ts:45`, `checks.ts` `endlessAnimations`) and the level meter does not transition under reduced motion. 2. **The gate change targets the wrong element.** `checks.ts:93-96` (not line 92) does `el.parentElement?.closest("[data-orientation]")`. In Astryx the thumb `div[role=slider]` is a direct child of `.astryx-slider-control`, which carries `data-orientation`, so the existing lookup already lands on the control. `.astryx-slider-track` is an `aria-hidden`, absolutely placed rail 4 px thick (`TRACK_SIZE = 4`, Slider.tsx:159); measuring it can never reach 24 or 44 px. What is actually wrong is size: the control is 20 px tall (`THUMB_SIZE`, Slider.tsx:160) and 24 px under `pointer: coarse` (Slider.tsx:188), against the gate's 24 px and 44 px. The old Radix root was `h-9 coarse:h-11`. Fix once in the theme (D3). In `checks.ts` make the lookup explicit (`closest(".astryx-slider-control, [data-orientation]")`) and add the harness case. 3. **The bespoke list is too short.** It names LevelMeter, pulse/blink and the docked bar. The port also needs a CSS Module for: `FocusedRecorder` (the timer is 64/80/96 px, 40 px on short screens, `Recorder.tsx:72`; `short:` and `lg:flex-1` rules), `LiveSheet` (the `role="log"` scroller needs a focus ring, a 68ch measure, the floating "Visa senaste" and an empty-or-visible status line), and `ReadyPanel`'s draft box (capped height `max-h-60`, `ReadyPanel.tsx:79`; Stack, Card and ScrollableArea have `height`, `maxWidth`, `minHeight` but no `maxHeight`). The bead scope allows `*.module.css` for all five files; the plan's Global Constraints allow it only for named bespoke surfaces. Decision D2. 4. **No "Cover" row.** The delete question (`ReadyPanel.tsx:200-223`) becomes a native top-layer dialog. Design D6.3: a dialog the page owns is closed while signed out and reopened on renewal. It needs a `session-cover.spec.ts` case and a `leaks.spec.ts` entry (section 7). 5. **The recording's layout lives in Phase 3's file.** `FlowInput.tsx:162` (`h-dvh` column), `:181-191` (`main` scroll rules), `:205-216` (the `Ljudet` section), `:255` and `components/frame.tsx:11` (`FRAME` = `px-4 md:px-8`) own the page the Phase 4 pieces sit in. `RecordingBar` is positioned against them (`Recorder.tsx:136-139`: `sticky bottom-0 -mx-4 mt-auto ... md:-mx-8 ... lg:mx-0`). Phase 4 may not edit `FlowInput.tsx`; the coupling is risk 1. 6. **Imports from other phases.** `Recorder.tsx` imports `ProblemAlert` (Phase 2); `ReadyPanel.tsx` imports `StateCard`, `STATE_HEADING` (Phase 3), `EarlierRuns` (Phase 3), `CopyButton` (Phase 6, takes the old `ButtonProps`), `ProblemAlert`. `AudioPlayer.tsx` exports are used by `ReviewView.tsx:21`, `RunResult.tsx:22` and `TranscriptPlayer.tsx:13,817-855` (Phases 6 and 7). `LevelMeter.tsx` exports are used by `MicrophoneCheck.tsx:8,130` (Phase 3, passes `className="h-6"`) and `recording-hooks.ts:4` (out of scope). The card lists none of this. Rule for the phase: every exported name and prop of the five files stays; `ReadyPanel` stops importing `STATE_HEADING`. 7. **Unit test list.** `live-audio.test.ts` imports only `components/flow/live-audio` (no UI): it is a no-regression guard for out-of-scope code, nothing to adapt. Missing from the list: `signed-out.test.ts:121-154` (`SignedOutControls`; expected to pass unchanged). Coupling is wider than `bg-primary` (section 4). 8. **`--record` must stay.** `lib/accessibility.test.ts:78-81` reads `--record` from `globals.css` and `tailwind.config.ts:64` maps it. Add `--module-color-record` beside it: light `#DC2828` (from `hsl(0 72% 51%)`, `globals.css:23`), dark `#DD2C2C` (from `hsl(0 72% 52%)`, `:75`), as `light-dark()`. Phase 7's theme-test rewrite must re-point to the new token (3:1 on card, muted and body in both modes). Worth adding to the Phase 7 card. 9. **"The delete question holds focus and gives it back"** holds only if the opener had focus: Astryx `Dialog` returns focus to `document.activeElement` captured at open (Dialog.tsx:515, :544). Safari and Firefox on macOS do not focus a button on click, so a click-opened question would return focus to `body`. The keyboard test (`keyboard.spec.ts:76`) uses Enter and will pass. Plan: keep a ref on "Ta bort" and focus it when the question closes without a discard. 10. **For other phases (found while reading, not mine to fix).** (a) Astryx `Spinner` under reduced motion still loops, at 3 s (Spinner.tsx:333-338): any scanned state that shows a Spinner trips `endlessAnimations` in the `reduced-motion` project; Phase 1's `page-loading` and `signin-loading` are candidates. (b) `names.spec.ts` "a page that is still loading says so" expects `getByRole("status", { name: "Laddar" })`; Astryx's own Swedish word is "Läser in" (`sv-SE.json` `@astryx.spinner.loading`, `@astryx.button.loading`), and Phase 1.6 names the spinner "Tal till text". ## 1. Files Change (exact paths, all under `frontend/`): - `components/flow/Recorder.tsx` + new `Recorder.module.css` - `components/flow/LevelMeter.tsx` + new `LevelMeter.module.css` (lines 61-124 only; `levelFromRms` and `useInputLevel`, lines 1-59, are behaviour and stay byte for byte) - `components/flow/LiveSheet.tsx` + new `LiveSheet.module.css` (D2) - `components/flow/AudioPlayer.tsx` (no CSS Module) - `components/flow/ReadyPanel.tsx` (+ `ReadyPanel.module.css` only if D2 allows the capped draft box) - `app/globals.css` (add `--module-color-record`; delete the dead pulse/blink; one forced-colours rule for the slider, D3) - `kit/theme/eneo.theme.ts` + regenerated `kit/theme/built/*` (D3) - `tests/e2e/checks.ts` (slider lookup only) + `tests/e2e/harness.spec.ts` (new case) - `tests/legacy-ui-files.json` (remove the 5 files), unit tests and ARIA snapshots of section 4 and 5 - also: `tests/e2e/leaks.spec.ts`, `tests/e2e/session-cover.spec.ts` (section 7), `tests/e2e/names.spec.ts` (two new tests, section 6). The bead scope does not name these three; the plan's overlay rule requires the first two. Lead: confirm. Not edited: `FlowInput.tsx`, `MicrophoneCheck.tsx`, `StateCard.tsx`, `ProblemAlert.tsx`, `EarlierRuns.tsx`, `CopyButton.tsx`, `TranscriptPlayer.tsx`, `ReviewView.tsx`, `RunResult.tsx`, `recording-hooks.ts`, anything under `lib/` except test files. Shared with another phase (merge is mechanical unless noted): - `tests/legacy-ui-files.json` (every phase). - ARIA snapshots: `recording-{390,1440}` is the whole `.app-shell`, so Phase 3 (top bar, details) and Phase 4 (region `Ljudet`) both change it: two reviewed diffs, one file, review the merged result. `signed-out-recording-*` is Phase 1's first. `ready-*`, `stromma-*`: region `Ljudet`, whose first `status` is Phase 2's `OfflineBanner`. - `app/globals.css` (Phase 7 moves `.transcript-*` out, Phase 8 strips Tailwind): different hunks. - `kit/theme/eneo.theme.ts` and the generated `kit/theme/built/*`: regenerate after any merge, never resolve by hand. - `tests/e2e/leaks.spec.ts`, `session-cover.spec.ts` (every phase with a dialog), `tests/e2e/checks.ts` (Phase 1 also changed it). - `lib/ready-view.test.ts` (Phase 3: `UploadPanel` and `EarlierRuns` lines; Phase 6: `Kopiera`; Phase 4: the ReadyPanel and player tests), `lib/interactions.test.ts` (Phase 1 line 454; Phase 4 lines 682-752), `lib/recording-view.test.ts`, `lib/playback.test.ts`. Phase 4 edits only the tests of its own components and leaves other phases' assertions as they are. ## 2. title: Phase 5: sending, progress, failure
description:
## Read first
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-astryx-port-plan.md`: "Global Constraints" and "How to work" (every time), then **"Phases 2–7 — Surface cards": the kickoff, and the Phase 5 card**.
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-platform-design.md`: decision D10 (widget swaps) and D6 (dialogs and the signed-out cover).
- `AGENTS.md` in the repository root, once Phase 0.4 has created it.

## Scope
Branch `feat/astryx-phase-5` from `feat/astryx` (merge `main` into `feat/astryx` first).

Files you may change, and no others in `app/` or `components/`:
- `frontend/components/flow/SubmittingView.tsx`, `RunProgress.tsx`, `StepList.tsx`, `StepDetails.tsx`, `RunFailure.tsx`
Plus: `frontend/tests/legacy-ui-files.json` (remove ported files, never add), the unit tests the card names (selectors
and class assertions only), the ARIA snapshots of this phase's states, `frontend/kit/theme/eneo.theme.ts` for a
design-system shortfall (then `npm run theme:build`).

## Out of scope
- `lib/submit-run.ts`, `lib/follow-run.ts`, `lib/run-progress.ts`: sending and polling are not touched.
- `backend/` and everything under `frontend/lib/` except the test files named in Scope.
- Screens and components that belong to another bead.
- Gate thresholds, gate states, axe exclusions, and the Astryx versions (exact pins).
- Ejecting ("swizzling") an Astryx component, authoring StyleX, adding Tailwind classes.
- Plan B (removing Next.js) and Plan C (the module kit).
- If something outside this scope looks wrong, write a comment on this bead (`br comments add`) and leave it alone.

## Steps
1. Kickoff, before any code: run this phase's gate states and unit tests (they must pass), run the loop in "How to
   work" for each screen, and write this phase's task list in the form of Phase 1's tasks (files, mapping table,
   behaviour to keep with the test that proves it, coupled tests, snapshots). Post it as a comment on this bead and
   get it reviewed before porting.
2. Port screen by screen following the card (`Banner`, `Collapsible`, `Skeleton`, `Spinner`, `AlertDialog`; `ProgressBar`/`Stepper` only under the swap rule). One commit per screen.
3. For each "widget swap to try" in the card: apply the rule in "Widget swaps". Record which path was taken.
4. Run the phase exit: lint, unit tests, build, this phase's gate states in all 19 projects, `test:prod`, screenshots and the page-cost table. Do not run the whole gate: the lead runs it after the merge.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Gate states pass in all 19 projects: `sending`, `run-progress`, `run-started`, `failure`.
- `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass; the gate states listed above pass in all 19 projects (`npm run test:a11y -- -g "<state>"` per state, on this worktree's own ports); `npm run test:prod` passes. The whole gate runs once, by the lead, after the phases are merged.
- `tests/e2e/session-cover.spec.ts` passes.
- Every file in Scope is off `tests/legacy-ui-files.json`: no string-literal `className`, no old imports.
- ARIA snapshots changed only for this phase's states, after reading the diff.
- Everything listed under "Keep" in the card still works, proved by the tests the card names.
- The sending view is a page with a heading that takes focus, a named progress bar and a spoken stage.
- Eneo's English words on the failure view keep `lang="en"`.
- `run-views.test.ts` asserts one `data-variant="primary"` action instead of `bg-primary`.
- The pull request into `feat/astryx` lists theme corrections, changed test expectations and widget-swap outcomes,
  with screenshots at phone-320-light, phone-390-dark, laptop-1440-light and ultrawide-3440-light.

## Verify
```bash
cd frontend
npm run lint && npm test
npm run test:a11y -- -g "<state>"          # each state of this phase
npm run build && npm run test:prod   # plus the states above, with A11Y_APP_PORT/A11Y_STUB_PORT set to this phase's own pair
```

## If blocked
Stop and comment on this bead instead of working around it when: a step's expected result does not appear after
one honest attempt to fix the cause; a stop condition in the plan ("Stop conditions") holds; or the task seems to
need a change outside Scope.

The phase's states are in the gate and pass in all 19 projects; session-cover passes; its files are off the legacy list (the list is deleted in Phase 8, with legacy-ui.test.ts as the guard).

title: Phase 0.1: apply the reference patch and install the pinned Astryx packages
description:
## Read first
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-astryx-port-plan.md`: "Global Constraints" and "How to work" (every time), then **Phase 0, Task 0.1 and Task 0.2**.
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-platform-design.md`: section 3 (what was verified) and section 4 (Astryx facts).
- `AGENTS.md` in the repository root, once Phase 0.4 has created it.
- `docs/plans/astryx-phase0-reference.patch`: read the file list at the top of each hunk before applying.

## Scope
Branch `feat/astryx-foundation` from `main`.

Files: exactly the 26 files in `docs/plans/astryx-phase0-reference.patch`, plus `frontend/package-lock.json`.

## Out of scope
- Porting any screen. Editing the patch's files beyond what the patch does. Installing any package the plan does not name (no `@astryxdesign/theme-neutral`).
- `backend/` and everything under `frontend/lib/` except the test files named in Scope.
- Screens and components that belong to another bead.
- Gate thresholds, gate states, axe exclusions, and the Astryx versions (exact pins).
- Ejecting ("swizzling") an Astryx component, authoring StyleX, adding Tailwind classes.
- Plan B (removing Next.js) and Plan C (the module kit).
- If something outside this scope looks wrong, write a comment on this bead (`br comments add`) and leave it alone.

## Steps
1. Confirm the start: `cd frontend && npm ci && npm run lint && npm test` (expected `# fail 0`).
2. From the repository root: `git apply --check docs/plans/astryx-phase0-reference.patch && git apply docs/plans/astryx-phase0-reference.patch`. If `--check` fails because `main`
   moved, apply file by file and resolve by hand; do not regenerate the files from memory.
3. `cd frontend && npm install --save-exact @astryxdesign/core@0.6.3 @stylexjs/stylex@0.19.1` and
   `npm install --save-dev --save-exact @astryxdesign/cli@0.6.3`.
4. `npm run astryx -- doctor`, then `npm run theme:build && git status --short kit/theme/built`.
5. Read every added file once with the table in Task 0.2 beside it.
6. Commit: `feat(ui): add the Astryx foundation beside the current UI`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `npm run astryx -- doctor` ends with `0 failures`.
- `npm run theme:build` prints three check marks and leaves `kit/theme/built/` unmodified.
- `package.json` lists the three Astryx-related packages with exact versions (no `^`).
- `npm run lint` exits 0 and `npm test` reports `# tests 640`, `# fail 0`.
- No screen a user sees has changed.

## Verify
```bash
cd frontend && npm run astryx -- doctor && npm run theme:build && git status --short kit/theme/built && npm run lint && npm test
```

## If blocked
Stop and comment on this bead instead of working around it when: a step's expected result does not appear after
one honest attempt to fix the cause; a stop condition in the plan ("Stop conditions") holds; or the task seems to
need a change outside Scope.

Installed exact pins core 0.6.3, stylex 0.19.1, cli 0.6.3. astryx doctor: 4 passed, 1 warning (no theme-* package, deliberate), 0 failures. theme:build rebuilds kit/theme/built with no diff. lint exit 0; npm test: 640 tests, 640 pass.

and class assertions only), the ARIA snapshots of this phase's states, `frontend/kit/theme/eneo.theme.ts` for a
design-system shortfall (then `npm run theme:build`).

- `components/TranscriptPlayer.tsx` (Phase 7): the result page keeps using it as it is.
- `lib/run-files.ts`, `lib/run-result.ts`, `lib/regenerate.ts`.

- Plan B (removing Next.js) and Plan C (the module kit).
- If something outside this scope looks wrong, write a comment on this bead (`br comments add`) and leave it alone.

## Steps
1. Kickoff, before any code: run this phase's gate states and unit tests (they must pass), run the loop in "How to
   work" for each screen, and write this phase's task list in the form of Phase 1's tasks (files, mapping table,
   behaviour to keep with the test that proves it, coupled tests, snapshots). Post it as a comment on this bead and

3. For each "widget swap to try" in the card: apply the rule in "Widget swaps". Record which path was taken.
4. Run the phase exit: lint, unit tests, build, this phase's gate states in all 19 projects, `test:prod`, screenshots and the page-cost table. Do not run the whole gate: the lead runs it after the merge.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Gate states pass in all 19 projects: `result`, `result-steps-open`, `result-pdf-dialog`, `result-transcript-tab`, `result-docked-player`, `result-regenerate`, `result-pdf-preview-whole`, `result-without-transcript`.

- `tests/e2e/session-cover.spec.ts` passes.
- Every file in Scope is off `tests/legacy-ui-files.json`: no string-literal `className`, no old imports.
- ARIA snapshots changed only for this phase's states, after reading the diff.
- Everything listed under "Keep" in the card still works, proved by the tests the card names.
- The PDF preview holds focus, never traps it in the browser's viewer, and Escape closes it from the dialog's controls.
- The PDF dialog is closed while signed out and reopened after (new `session-cover` case).
- Result headings keep a valid page outline.
- The pull request into `feat/astryx` lists theme corrections, changed test expectations and widget-swap outcomes,
  with screenshots at phone-320-light, phone-390-dark, laptop-1440-light and ultrawide-3440-light.

## Verify
```bash
cd frontend
npm run lint && npm test
npm run test:a11y -- -g "<state>"          # each state of this phase
npm run build && npm run test:prod   # plus the states above, with A11Y_APP_PORT/A11Y_STUB_PORT set to this phase's own pair
```

Stop and comment on this bead instead of working around it when: a step's expected result does not appear after
one honest attempt to fix the cause; a stop condition in the plan ("Stop conditions") holds; or the task seems to
need a change outside Scope.

Author: sonnet-kickoff6. Read-only pass on `feat/astryx-foundation` (9419653). Astryx facts come from `npm run astryx -- component <Name>` and from `node_modules/@astryxdesign/core/src` (0.6.3); where the CLI table and the source differ, the source is cited.

The checkout has no Phase 1 yet (`kit/ModuleShell.tsx` is absent, every file is still on `tests/legacy-ui-files.json`). Everything said about `ModuleShell` and `AppShell` below is taken from the plan, not read from code.

## 0. Decisions needed from the lead before coding (card errors, in order of damage)

1. **Who owns the result page's frame, and its `<main>`?** `RunResult.tsx:154` renders its own `<main id="innehall">`; `app/flows/[id]/page.tsx:681-684` renders `<FlowTopBar title=... />` as a sibling of `<RunResult>`. The plan (line 26) says a ported page renders no `<main>`, and Phase 3 turns `FlowTopBar` into the `ModuleShell` heading. No bead owns `app/flows/[id]/page.tsx` (Phase 3's Scope lists FlowTopBar, FlowRunPage, FlowPageStates and others, not page.tsx; Phase 6's Scope forbids it). Two mains or none breaks `page.getByRole("main")` (aria.spec.ts:26-28, names.spec.ts) in every result state. Proposal: Phase 6 starts after Phase 3 merges (add `.20` blocked by `.17`); Phase 3 owns the page.tsx edit (frame around `RunResult`, `FlowTopBar` sibling removed at page.tsx:682); `RunResult` then renders content only: no `<main>`, no top bar. Until then Phase 6 may keep a bare `<main id="innehall">` (no className) as the only legacy element.
2. **"Bespoke: none" cannot hold.** Five behaviours have no Astryx prop (checked: `Grid` has `columns: number | {minWidth,max,repeat}` only; `LayoutPanel`/`LayoutContent`/`Section`/`Card` have no sticky or max-height; `Dialog` height is `fit-content` with `maxHeight`): the 7fr/6fr two-column grid from 1024 px (RunResult.tsx:186), the sticky transcript column (:211), the transcript card capped at `100dvh - 3rem` with its text scrolling inside (RunTranscript.tsx:127), the docked pause bar `sticky bottom-0` with safe-area padding and `short:static` (RunResult.tsx:233), and the PDF iframe filling the dialog (ResultFiles.tsx:163,200). Ask: allow three CSS Modules using only Astryx tokens plus structural widths: `RunResult.module.css`, `RunTranscript.module.css`, `ResultFiles.module.css`. Fallback if refused: equal columns, no sticky column, a static pause bar, a fixed-height iframe; each is a regression the owner must accept (the pause bar is gate state `result-docked-player`).
3. **Button labels do not wrap.** `Button.tsx:86` sets `white-space: nowrap`; `Button.tsx:145-149` makes the label `overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis`. The old buttons wrap on purpose (RegenerateNotice.tsx:53, StepDetails.tsx:21, ResultFiles.tsx:51). At 320 px or 200 % zoom "Skapa dokumentet igen med rättningarna" and a file name as a button are cut with an ellipsis (the gate lists ellipsis apart, `checks.ts:216-217`, and only fails headings, `a11y.spec.ts:71`, so the gate stays green while words are lost). One theme correction in `kit/theme/eneo.theme.ts` (`button.base`: `whiteSpace: 'normal'`, `height: 'auto'`, `minHeight: var(--size-element-md)`) serves Phases 3, 5 and 6; decide once, who lands it.
4. **Scope is short of what the plan requires.** Add to Scope: `tests/e2e/leaks.spec.ts` (plan line 37 requires every new overlay there; today every overlay is opened on `/dev/foundation`, `leaks.spec.ts:78`, so a `go` per overlay must be added, once), `lib/run-views.test.ts` (it mounts RunResult, ResultFiles and RunTranscriptView and is not in the card's unit test list), `RunResult.module.css`, `RunTranscript.module.css`, `ResultFiles.module.css`. Also allow NEW unit tests for the edge cases in section 7 (the bead says "selectors and class assertions only").
5. **Card text that is wrong against the code:** (a) "result-document.test.ts (lines 34, 126, 235)": line 235 is the speaker-change dialog of `TranscriptPlayer` (Phase 7), not this phase; this phase's coupled lines are listed in section 4. (b) "Below a laptop's width the PDF opens in a new tab": true for the document's own row (`lg`, ResultFiles.tsx:130,149); the "Fler filer" rows switch at `sm` (640 px), ResultFiles.tsx:139,155. (c) Phase 8 line 719 removes `react-markdown` and `remark-gfm` "only if Phase 6 moved to Astryx Markdown", but `ReviewView.tsx:592` also renders `ReactMarkdown` and `ReviewView.tsx:26` imports `remarkResultHeadings` from `ResultDocument.tsx`: the condition is Phase 6 and Phase 7. (d) Gate state `result-steps-open` clicks `StepDetails` (Phase 5's file); its ARIA/behaviour is Phase 5's while this phase must keep it green. (e) `usePhaseHeading.ts:12-13` exports `PHASE_HEADING`, a Tailwind class string used by every phase's heading; no card lists it. RunResult stops using it; Phase 8 must delete it.
6. **Shared ARIA snapshots.** `result-390/1440`, `result-regenerate-390/1440`, `result-transcript-tab-390` also contain Phase 5's `button "Hur resultatet togs fram 2 steg"`, Phase 7's whole `TranscriptPlayer` subtree and Phase 3's `link "Alla flöden"`. Phase 6 updates only its own hunks; the lead regenerates once after merging 3, 5, 6, 7.
7. **Programmatic focus on the h1.** `PHASE_HEADING` carries `outline-none`; Astryx `Heading` has no focus styling and `reset.css` has no `:focus-visible` rule, so `heading.focus()` (usePhaseHeading) may draw a ring on every visit (Phases 5, 6, 7). Check once in Chromium; if a ring shows, one theme rule, not per call site.

## 1. Files

Change (all under `frontend/`):
- `components/flow/CopyButton.tsx`, `RegenerateNotice.tsx`, `RunTranscript.tsx`, `ResultFiles.tsx`, `ResultDocument.tsx`, `RunResult.tsx`

|---|---|---|
| `tests/legacy-ui-files.json`, ARIA snapshots | all | mechanical merge; result snapshots see decision 6 |
| `lib/run-views.test.ts` | 5 | Phase 5: lines 199-200, 316-317. Phase 6: 99-119 (ResultFiles), 120-140 (RunResult), 370-455 (RunTranscriptView) |

## 2. Mapping, per file (every prop checked with the CLI or the source)

Legend: D = direct, W = widget swap to try, K = keep custom with Astryx controls.

### CopyButton.tsx (commit 1)
| Today | Astryx | |
|---|---|---|
| `Button variant=outline/ghost` + `Check/Copy` icon + sr-only words | `Button variant="secondary"\|"ghost" size label={name ?? text} icon={<Icon icon="checkDouble"\|"copy" />}` and visible words as `children`. Button sets `aria-label=label` when `children` differs (Button.tsx:726-734), so the visible words stay inside the name (WCAG 2.5.3). `disabled` -> `isDisabled` (no tooltip, so native `disabled`). | D |

## 8. Order, risks, and a split into independent chunks

Risks, most damaging first:
1. Frame and `<main>` ownership between Phase 3, Phase 6 and `page.tsx` (decision 1). Every result state fails on `getByRole("main")` if two phases both render or both omit it.
2. Layout behaviours with no Astryx prop vs "Bespoke: none" (decision 2), and `Layout` becoming a scroll container (breaks the tab reading positions).
3. Button/Tab labels never wrap (decision 3): lost words at 320 px that the gate does not catch.
4. Eager PDF iframes inside an always-mounted `Dialog` (up to N x 25 MB on page load), plus focus restore on Safari/Firefox.
5. Tabs: manual activation, click not mousedown, doubled label in `textContent`, `hidden` losing to Astryx display classes.
6. Markdown heading normalisation (needs the remark adapter or the fallback); Phase 8's removal condition is wrong (Phase 6 and 7).
7. Weight: `/flows/flow-1` budget is 430 KB JS (`tests/prod/weight-budget.json`); Dialog, DropdownMenu, TabList, Banner, Markdown and Item enter that route while `react-markdown` stays until Phase 7. Measure with `node docs/plans/page-cost.cjs` before and after and say why in the PR if the budget moves.
8. Shared snapshots and tests with Phases 3, 5, 7 (decision 6, section 1).
9. `download` is not on `ButtonProps` (typed `as` link needed); native-dialog `inDialog` in `checks.ts`.

Chunks (no two share a source file; shared test files are disjoint hunks that git merges; run each file once after the merge):
- **A, leaf pieces (first, small):** `CopyButton.tsx`, `RegenerateNotice.tsx`, `RunTranscript.tsx` (+ `RunTranscript.module.css`), `lib/regenerate.test.ts`, `lib/run-views.test.ts:370-455`. Gate: `result-regenerate`, transcript header in `result`. Commits 1-2.
- **B, files and the PDF dialog:** `ResultFiles.tsx` (+ `ResultFiles.module.css`, `useMediaMatch`), `ResultDocument.tsx` (Markdown swap, menu, share), `lib/result-document.test.ts` (document, file, dialog, share, preview tests), `lib/run-views.test.ts:99-119`, `tests/e2e/session-cover.spec.ts`, `leaks.spec.ts` entries. Gate: `result-pdf-dialog`, `result-pdf-preview-whole`, `result-without-transcript`, `session-cover.spec.ts`. Commit 3. B depends on A only through `useCopy`/`CopyStatus`, whose signatures do not change.
- **C, frame and tabs:** `RunResult.tsx` (+ `RunResult.module.css`), the RunResult mounts in `lib/result-document.test.ts` (:134-242, :279-323, :393-462, :503-529) and `lib/run-views.test.ts:120-140`, the `result*` snapshots (own hunks), the keyboard and reading-position tests. Gate: `result`, `result-steps-open`, `result-transcript-tab`, `result-docked-player`. Commit 4. C can be coded against the old children (their props do not change) and is verified last, after A and B land and after decision 1.
Merge order: A, B, C, then `tests/legacy-ui-files.json` (6 lines), then the phase exit (lint, `npm test`, build, the 8 states x 19 projects, `test:prod`, page-cost table, shots at phone-320-light, phone-390-dark, laptop-1440-light, ultrawide-3440-light). PR lists: theme corrections (3, 7), changed expectations (section 4), accepted changes (arrow keys only move focus on tabs; the dialog's close is an X named "Stäng"; the file name is no longer a stretched row target; the dialog description is not linked), and widget-swap outcomes (Markdown path; Toast rejected; Stepper n/a).

title: Phase 7: review, speaker naming, transcript player and editor
description:
## Read first
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-astryx-port-plan.md`: "Global Constraints" and "How to work" (every time), then **"Phases 2–7 — Surface cards": the kickoff, and the Phase 7 card**.
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-platform-design.md`: decision D10 (widget swaps) and D6 (dialogs and the signed-out cover).
- `AGENTS.md` in the repository root, once Phase 0.4 has created it.

## Scope
Branch `feat/astryx-phase-7` from `feat/astryx` (merge `main` into `feat/astryx` first).

Files you may change, and no others in `app/` or `components/`:
- `frontend/components/flow/ReviewView.tsx`, `frontend/components/SpeakerNamingDialog.tsx`, `NameCombobox.tsx`, `TranscriptPlayer.tsx`, `TranscriptEditor.tsx` and their new `*.module.css`
- `frontend/app/dev/speaker-review/ReviewFixtures.tsx`
- `frontend/app/globals.css`: move the `.transcript-*` rules out, add `--module-speaker-0` … `-5`
- `frontend/lib/accessibility.test.ts`: rewritten to read the built theme, every ratio kept
Plus: `frontend/tests/legacy-ui-files.json` (remove ported files, never add), the unit tests the card names (selectors
and class assertions only), the ARIA snapshots of this phase's states, `frontend/kit/theme/eneo.theme.ts` for a
design-system shortfall (then `npm run theme:build`).

## Out of scope
- `lib/transcript*.ts`, `lib/speaker-*.ts`, `lib/playback.ts`, `lib/confirmed-words.ts`, the `use*` hooks beside the components: selection, playback and correction logic are not touched.
- The semantic HTML and `data-*` attributes of the transcript text.
- `backend/` and everything under `frontend/lib/` except the test files named in Scope.
- Screens and components that belong to another bead.
- Gate thresholds, gate states, axe exclusions, and the Astryx versions (exact pins).
- Ejecting ("swizzling") an Astryx component, authoring StyleX, adding Tailwind classes.
- Plan B (removing Next.js) and Plan C (the module kit).
- If something outside this scope looks wrong, write a comment on this bead (`br comments add`) and leave it alone.

## Steps
1. Kickoff, before any code: run this phase's gate states and unit tests (they must pass), run the loop in "How to
   work" for each screen, and write this phase's task list in the form of Phase 1's tasks (files, mapping table,
   behaviour to keep with the test that proves it, coupled tests, snapshots). Post it as a comment on this bead and
   get it reviewed before porting.
2. Port screen by screen following the card (bespoke surfaces allowed a CSS Module: `TranscriptPlayer`, `TranscriptEditor`; controls inside them are Astryx). One commit per screen.
3. For each "widget swap to try" in the card: apply the rule in "Widget swaps". Record which path was taken.
4. Run the phase exit: lint, unit tests, build, this phase's gate states in all 19 projects, `test:prod`, screenshots and the page-cost table. Do not run the whole gate: the lead runs it after the merge.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Gate states pass in all 19 projects: `review`, `naming-dialog`, `review-reject`, `review-text-edit`, `review-din-version`.
- `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass; the gate states listed above pass in all 19 projects (`npm run test:a11y -- -g "<state>"` per state, on this worktree's own ports); `npm run test:prod` passes. The whole gate runs once, by the lead, after the phases are merged.
- `tests/e2e/session-cover.spec.ts` passes.
- Every file in Scope is off `tests/legacy-ui-files.json`: no string-literal `className`, no old imports.
- ARIA snapshots changed only for this phase's states, after reading the diff.
- Everything listed under "Keep" in the card still works, proved by the tests the card names.
- Everything `README.md` "Granska transkriptet" describes still works.
- The naming dialog closes while signed out and reopens with its typed names (`session-cover.spec.ts`, first test); its field state lives above the dialog.
- `lib/accessibility.test.ts` keeps every contrast ratio and "the first speaker is not the brand's blue".
- The pull request into `feat/astryx` lists theme corrections, changed test expectations and widget-swap outcomes,
  with screenshots at phone-320-light, phone-390-dark, laptop-1440-light and ultrawide-3440-light.

## Verify
```bash
cd frontend
npm run lint && npm test
npm run test:a11y -- -g "<state>"          # each state of this phase
npm run build && npm run test:prod   # plus the states above, with A11Y_APP_PORT/A11Y_STUB_PORT set to this phase's own pair
```

## If blocked
Stop and comment on this bead instead of working around it when: a step's expected result does not appear after
one honest attempt to fix the cause; a stop condition in the plan ("Stop conditions") holds; or the task seems to
need a change outside Scope.

The phase's states are in the gate and pass in all 19 projects; session-cover passes; its files are off the legacy list (the list is deleted in Phase 8, with legacy-ui.test.ts as the guard).

comments.text:
## Phase 7 kickoff (author: sonnet-kickoff7; read-only: nothing was run, built or started) Not done here: the baseline run of this phase's gate states and unit tests (step 1 of the bead). Phase 1 is not merged on the branch I read (`kit/` holds only the theme and `ModuleProviders`; no `ModuleShell`). The implementer runs the baseline first. Every Astryx prop below was read with `npm run astryx -- component ` or in `node_modules/@astryxdesign/core/src`; where a prop I need does not exist I say so. `npm run astryx -- build` found no page template ("frame with AppShell, then compose"); the closest blocks are `DialogScrollingContent` (skeleton: `Dialog > Layout header={DialogHeader} content={LayoutContent} footer={LayoutFooter}`) and `Toolbar`. ### 0. Decisions needed from the lead before coding 1. **Frame of ReviewView depends on Phases 1, 3 and 6.** ReviewView renders its own `FlowTopBar` and `
` (ReviewView.tsx:446, 453, 559); `app/flows/[id]/page.tsx:634` renders it and is on no card. After the port the frame is `ModuleShell` (Phase 1.1) with Phase 3's flow heading (way back + name below lg, brand from lg). Bead .21 is blocked only by .15; the frame commit also needs Phase 3's heading export and Phase 3 must keep `FRAME`/`ReadingMain` in `components/frame.tsx` until Phase 8 (ReviewView imports both today). Add .21 depends on .17 for that commit, or fix the interface now. 2. **Markdown of the text review** (ReviewView.tsx:18-19, 590-593): react-markdown + `remarkResultHeadings` imported from Phase 6's `ResultDocument.tsx` + `prose` classes. Phase 7 follows Phase 6's outcome (Astryx `Markdown` with `headingLevelStart`, or react-markdown + CSS Module). `names.spec.ts:116` needs exactly one `article`. 3. **CSS Module for ReviewView.** Bead Scope allows `ReviewView.module.css`; plan Global Constraints allow Modules only on the card's bespoke surfaces. The lg two-column frame (ReviewView.tsx:464, 2fr/3fr, xl 5fr/8fr) and the transcript card height (:530, `lg:max-h-[calc(100vh-14rem)]`) cannot be written with `Grid` (`columns` is a count or auto-fill `{minWidth,max,repeat}`) or `Layout` panels. Same escape as Phase 3's two-column frame. Proposed: allowed, structural widths only. 4. **The flag-on editor has no gate.** `NEXT_PUBLIC_SPEAKER_REVIEW_ENABLED` defaults to false (`frontend/Dockerfile:9`, root `Dockerfile:12`, `docker-compose.yml:41`; `playwright.config.ts` sets none; `screens.ts:627` waits for "Vem är vem?", which only the flag-off path shows, ReviewView.tsx:98-101). `TranscriptEditor` (README "Granska transkriptet") is reached only by `/dev/speaker-review`, which no spec visits (only `tests/accessibility-audit.cjs`, not in CI), and by SSR string tests. The acceptance line "everything README describes still works" is therefore unproven for the largest port. Proposed: add gate state(s) that open `/dev/speaker-review` (`next dev` serves it; `test:prod` does not), case "accessibility" with the audio box ticked, in `tests/e2e/screens.ts` (not in the bead's Scope list; adding a state is allowed by the plan, deleting is not), plus two Playwright tests on it (Shift+Arrow selection then Tilldela talare then Ångra; click a word moves playback). 5. **Inline controls inside text cannot be Astryx `Button`.** The card says controls inside the bespoke surfaces are Astryx. The turn clock, the per-passage "Rätta" pencil, the word-confirm check and the speaker-name button sit in running text and use negative margins to keep a 44 px touch target without growing the line (TranscriptPlayer.tsx:984, 998, 1106, 1150, `coarse:-my-2.5 coarse:min-h-11`); Astryx `Button` takes `--size-element-*` (44 px coarse) as its own height. Proposed: those four stay plain `

comments.author: ph7
comments.text: ph7, leaks 'change-speaker popover' 88 nodes (872bd8e on feat/astryx-ph7, tests/e2e/leaks.spec.ts only; thresholds untouched). Cause, from a heap snapshot: Astryx useFocusTrap keeps lastFocusRef (the last element focused inside a popover) after close, which retains that popover's closed form (88 detached-live nodes, 12 listeners) until the popover is opened again: one form per popover instance, never one per opening, so not a leak that grows. Focus enters ~50 ms after the popover shows; the entry waited only for the wrapper and pressed Escape at once, so a warm-up closed too soon was baselined WITHOUT the form and later openings WITH it (warm 1027/1072, after 1115/1084 = +88/+12). Reproduced on the merged tree with a cold .next and CPU load (1 of 3 runs); not by workers 1/2/4 alone; forced by closing the warm-up before focus (counters 1023/1072 vs 1115/1084). Fix: the opening waits for focus in the popover. After: whole file workers=4 twice (first cold) 21/21, entry alone green, lint clean. Design-system finding (not changed, pinned): a long transcript keeps one retained form per passage opened (bounded by passages, ~88 nodes each).

title: Merge feat/astryx to main: the ported UI ships
description:
## Read first
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-astryx-port-plan.md`: "Global Constraints" and "How to work" (every time), then **"Global Constraints" (branches) and the line after the Phase 7 card**.
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-platform-design.md`: section 12, decision 7 (ship all at once).
- `AGENTS.md` in the repository root, once Phase 0.4 has created it.

## Scope
Branch `feat/astryx`. Merge conflicts with `main` only; no new porting.

## Out of scope
- Phase 8 (removing the old system) — its own bead and pull request.
- `backend/` and everything under `frontend/lib/` except the test files named in Scope.
- Screens and components that belong to another bead.
- Gate thresholds, gate states, axe exclusions, and the Astryx versions (exact pins).
- Ejecting ("swizzling") an Astryx component, authoring StyleX, adding Tailwind classes.
- Plan B (removing Next.js) and Plan C (the module kit).
- If something outside this scope looks wrong, write a comment on this bead (`br comments add`) and leave it alone.

## Steps
1. Merge `main` into `feat/astryx`; resolve conflicts keeping `main`'s behaviour changes and the ported markup.
2. Run the full exit and `docker build -t eneo-mod-speech-to-text:test .` from the repository root.
3. `SHOTS=1 npm run test:a11y -- a11y.spec.ts --project=phone-390-light --project=laptop-1440-dark`; read the images.
4. When the owner asks: open the pull request `feat/astryx` → `main`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `tests/legacy-ui-files.json` lists only `app/dev/foundation/FoundationCheck.tsx`.
- `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run test:a11y`, `npm run test:prod` and the Docker build pass.
- `backend` tests pass unchanged (`.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests`).
- The pull request is merged to `main`.

## Verify
```bash
cd frontend && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:a11y && npm run test:prod
cd .. && docker build -t eneo-mod-speech-to-text:test .
```

## If blocked
Stop and comment on this bead instead of working around it when: a step's expected result does not appear after
one honest attempt to fix the cause; a stop condition in the plan ("Stop conditions") holds; or the task seems to
need a change outside Scope.

title: Cleanup: remove the scaffolding made only for this work (Beads, plan docs, migration agent files)
description:

## Read first

## Scope

Remove, each in its own commit so any one can be reverted:
1. `.beads/` (the board). First export it for the record: `br sync --flush-only` and keep a copy of `.beads/issues.jsonl` outside the repository (the owner decides where), then delete the directory and any `.beads` entries in `.gitignore`.
2. The migration-only content of the root `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md`: the port plan references, the Tailwind/shadcn rules, the legacy-ui list, and the Beads line. Remove both files when nothing permanent is left in them.

4. `frontend/tests/legacy-ui-files.json` and `frontend/lib/legacy-ui.test.ts` (already removed by Phase 8; verify).
5. Local leftovers outside the repository: git worktrees created for this work (`git worktree list`), merged branches (`feat/astryx*`, `fix/next-audit`, `docs/astryx-plan`, `chore/*`), scratch directories.

Ask the owner before deleting, and decide with them, whether to keep: `frontend/AGENTS.md` (the Astryx block, refreshed by `astryx upgrade`; it is what keeps future agents using Astryx correctly), the `astryx` npm script, and `kit/` agent notes. Default: keep `frontend/AGENTS.md` and the script; remove everything else listed above.

## Out of scope

title: Fix: ARIA snapshots hard-code September for a real-clock recording name
description:
The `ready` and `unsent-recordings` ARIA snapshots match a recording's name with a literal month: `/Inspelning \d+ sep \d+:\d+/`. The name comes from the real clock, so these four snapshot files fail in every month but September. Found on 2026-10-01 when the whole gate ran: 4 failed, 1358 passed, the only difference being "okt" for "sep". It is not caused by the `next` bump or by Astryx; it fails on unchanged `main`.

## Read first
- `frontend/tests/e2e/aria.spec.ts` (`SNAPSHOTS`, `fixedTime`) and the four snapshot files below.

## Out of scope
- The `setup`, `setup-participants` snapshots: those states freeze the clock at 24 September, so their literal `sep` is correct.
- Freezing the clock for `ready` and `unsent-recordings`: the recorder measures elapsed time, and the existing snapshots already treat day, hour, minute and length as patterns. Only the month was left literal.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `aria ready` and `aria unsent-recordings` pass at phone-390-light and laptop-1440-light in any month.
- No other snapshot changed.

## Verify
```bash
cd frontend && npx playwright test aria.spec.ts -g "aria ready|aria unsent-recordings" --project=phone-390-light --project=laptop-1440-light
```

title: Security: bump the backend's FastAPI stack past 14 advisories and audit Python in CI
description:
`pip-audit` on the backend's pins (`fastapi==0.115.0`, `python-multipart==0.0.12`; resolved Starlette 0.38.6) reports 14 advisories in two packages, none fixed by the current pins. Found 2026-10-01 while checking the port for security and performance. This is independent of the Astryx port and affects production on `main`.

Relevant to this module (uploads and the proxy):
- python-multipart 0.0.12: multipart parser denial of service through a large preamble/epilogue or unbounded part headers (CVE-2026-40347, CVE-2026-42561), excessive logging per byte (CVE-2024-53981), a negative `Content-Length` that loads the whole body into memory (CVE-2026-53540), urlencoded parser CPU cost and `;` separator mismatch (CVE-2026-53538/53539). Fixed in 0.0.31.
- Starlette 0.38.6: unbounded buffering of multipart parts without a filename (CVE-2024-47874, fixed 0.40.0); the event loop blocks while a large upload rolls over to disk (CVE-2025-54121, fixed 0.47.2); request URL reconstruction from an unvalidated Host or path (X41-2026-002, CVE-2026-54282); form limits ignored for urlencoded bodies (CVE-2026-54283, fixed 1.3.1).
FastAPI reads the request body before it runs a route's `Depends(...)` for a `File(...)` parameter, so the multipart cost can be reached before the session check.

Trial (copies and throwaway virtualenvs only): FastAPI 0.142.2, Starlette 1.7.0, uvicorn 0.54.0, httpx 0.28.1, itsdangerous 2.2.0, python-multipart 0.0.32, websockets 17.1. `pip-audit`: no known vulnerabilities. The backend's 117 tests pass on those versions, and pass on the old pins too (the logged tracebacks are expected test noise). The tests do not exercise real large uploads or the live relay against the new uvicorn and websockets.

## Read first
- `backend/requirements.txt`, `backend/requirements-runtime.txt`, `backend/Dockerfile`, `Dockerfile`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (the `backend` job), `README.md` section "Dependency security".

## Scope
Branch `fix/backend-deps` from `main`. Files: `backend/requirements.txt` (exact pins to the versions above), `backend/requirements-runtime.txt` if it needs a change, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (one new step in the `backend` job), `README.md` (one sentence in "Dependency security").
The new CI step mirrors the frontend's existing "Audit production dependencies" step: install the pinned requirements, then `pip-audit` the installed set (`pip install pip-audit && pip-audit`), failing on any known vulnerability.

## Out of scope
- `backend/app/` code changes beyond what a new version forces (none were needed in the trial).
- Enabling Dependabot or any PR automation: `README.md` says that needs a separate decision.
- The frontend, the module kit repository (it has its own bead for the same finding).

## Steps to Reproduce
`uv venv --python 3.12 v && uv pip install --python v/bin/python -r backend/requirements.txt && uvx pip-audit --path v/lib/python3.12/site-packages` on `main`: 14 known vulnerabilities in python-multipart 0.0.12 and starlette 0.38.6.

## Steps
1. Reproduce: build a venv from the current pins and run `pip-audit` (14 findings).
2. Change the pins; build a fresh venv; `pip-audit` reports none.
3. `cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes (117).
4. Real-behaviour check, since the tests do not cover it: with the stub backend, upload a 200 MB file through `/api/eneo/flows/{id}/files` (the module's upload route) and record the process's peak memory before and after the bump; open the live relay WebSocket against the existing relay tests' fake Eneo and send one oversized frame (expect close 1009/1008 as in `test_live_relay.py`). Write the numbers in the pull request.
5. Add the CI step. Build the image: `docker build -t eneo-mod-speech-to-text:test .` and start it with `docker run` plus the health check from the README.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `pip-audit` on the pinned set reports no known vulnerabilities.
- The 117 backend tests pass; the image builds and answers `/health`.
- Peak memory for a 200 MB upload is no higher than before the bump (numbers in the PR).
- CI fails when a pinned package has a known vulnerability (show it once by temporarily pinning `python-multipart==0.0.12` on a scratch branch).

## Verify
```bash
cd backend && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt pip-audit && .venv/bin/pip-audit && .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests
```

## If blocked
Stop and comment on this bead. Do not pin around a test failure.
close_reason:
Done on branch fix/backend-deps (local commit f885517 on worktree /Users/ccimen/eneo/eneo-mod-stt-next-audit, not pushed).
Pins: fastapi 0.142.2, starlette 1.7.0 (now explicit: fastapi only requires starlette>=0.46.0, so it floated), uvicorn[standard] 0.54.0, httpx 0.28.1, itsdangerous 2.2.0, python-multipart 0.0.32, websockets 17.1. requirements-runtime.txt unchanged: root Dockerfile (via -r), backend/Dockerfile, CI and devcontainer all install requirements.txt. No change under backend/app.
pip-audit: old pins 14 unique advisories (pip-audit prints 28 rows, each twice; python-multipart 7, starlette 7), exit 1; new pins "No known vulnerabilities found", exit 0.
Tests: 117 pass on old and on new (backend unittest discover). New versions emit two deprecation warnings: FastAPI on_event at backend/app/main.py:87, and starlette.testclient with httpx (wants httpx2). Neither fails; not fixed (out of scope).
200 MB upload via /api/eneo/flows/{id}/files, real module under uvicorn (production flags, access_code login, stub Eneo; stub received 209,715,377 B every run), module RSS idle -> peak, 50 ms psutil sampling, 3 runs each:
 old: 55.9->58.6, 55.8->60.1, 55.9->59.0 MB (kernel ru_maxrss 58.8/60.2/59.1)
 new: 59.0->63.4, 59.4->63.6, 59.2->63.2 MB (kernel ru_maxrss 63.5/63.8/63.4)
Upload is spooled to disk, not buffered: growth under load is 3-4 MB on both. Absolute peak is about 4 MB (7%) higher on new, entirely from a 3.3 MB higher post-import baseline (new transitive dep opentelemetry-api, newer pydantic/starlette), not from the upload path. Upload time 0.35-0.42 s on both.
Live relay WebSocket (production --ws-max-size 131072): frame of exactly 131072 B accepted and relayed on both; 131073 B random frame closes with 1009 on both, Eneo stub saw only the accepted frame. Difference: close reason text is empty on old, "frame with N bytes exceeds limit of 131072 bytes" on new; the frontend reads only the close code.
CI: new step "Audit production dependencies" in the backend job. It freezes the installed set BEFORE installing pip-audit, then runs pip-audit --requirement <frozen> --no-deps --disable-pip. Reason: the literal "pip install pip-audit && pip-audit" audits 51 packages, 26 of them pip-audit's own dependencies plus the runner's pip, which are not shipped and would fail the gate on unrelated advisories; this audits the 25 shipped packages. Extracted the step from the YAML (pyyaml parse OK) and ran it verbatim in seeded venvs: new pins exit 0; with python-multipart==0.0.12 installed: "Found 14 known vulnerabilities in 1 package", exit 1.
Image: docker build -t eneo-mod-speech-to-text:test . exit 0; docker run with .env.example + COOKIE_SECURE=false + fake ENEO_*: GET :3001/health 200 {"ok":true}, supervisor backend+frontend RUNNING, in-container versions match the pins; container stopped and removed (image tag left in the local daemon).
README "Dependency security": one sentence added that CI audits npm (high+) and pip-audit (all); Dependabot paragraph untouched.

title: Backend security: cap request bodies and never read a body before auth (same P0s as kit .22)
description:
Found by kit-perf in the module kit's BFF, which was carved from this backend. Two of the same problems are visible in this repo's source (read, not yet reproduced here):

- `backend/app/main.py` ~715: the allowlisted proxy does `body = await request.body()` with no size cap, then forwards `upstream.content`. In the kit the same shape peaked at ~2.07x the body in RSS (50 MB -> +105 MB; one authenticated 700 MB POST OOM-killed a 768 MB container).
- `backend/app/main.py` ~379, 408, 439: the upload routes take `upload_file: UploadFile = File(...)` and list `Depends(module_auth.require_session)` in the decorator. FastAPI parses the multipart body before dependencies run, so an unauthenticated 300 MB upload is spooled to /tmp and read before the 401.

## What to do
Mirror the kit's fix once kit bead kit-module-kit-ojs.22 has landed and passed its adversary review: stream the proxy body with a running cap (413), parse uploads after auth with Content-Length required and capped, and bound other bodies before auth. Reproduce each failure on THIS backend first (failing test), then fix. Do not design a second solution; reuse the kit's tested one.

## Acceptance
Failing-then-passing tests for the proxy cap, the pre-auth upload (401 with body unread) and the over-cap 413; measured RSS for a large authenticated and a large unauthenticated request; backend suite green.

title: Astryx AlertDialog mounted per opening leaks DOM nodes (39 per 40 openings): find the cause
description: From p1b (.13): mounting the leave question (Astryx AlertDialog) per opening leaks 39 nodes per 40 openings in leaks.spec; always-mounted leaks 0. p1b kept it always-mounted and did not diagnose why. Every later phase's confirmation (delete question, regenerate, speaker naming) will use the same component, so the pattern must be understood once. Deliver: a minimal repro, the cause (our usage or the library), the rule every phase follows (documented in frontend/AGENTS or the kit), and a leaks.spec case that fails on the wrong pattern. If it is a library bug, a short upstream-ready note and the workaround. Not in scope: ejecting or patching Astryx. Branch off feat/astryx; 4-project loop and leaks.spec only; no full gate.
close_reason: Branch fix/alertdialog-leak 70c3455. Cause found: Chromium retains the last pointer-target element (one removed dialog, 25-39 nodes) until the pointer moves; not Astryx, not growth. leaks.spec now moves the pointer after each close; fixture app/dev/dialog-leak; 9 leak cases pass (laptop-1440-light), the deliberately leaking dialog fails as expected; per-opening AlertDialog +39 without the move, 0 with it. Rule in root AGENTS.md. 4-project states 22 passed, session-cover 24 passed, npm test 664/0, lint, build ok.

comments.author: sonnet-p1b
comments.text: Cause: not Astryx, not our usage, not growth. Chromium (153) keeps the element last under the pointer after it is removed, and everything removed with it, until the pointer moves. An overlay mounted for each opening and closed by a click leaves ONE dialog's nodes behind: 25 for Dialog, 39 for AlertDialog (its bigger tree). Count after each opening is 0 or constant (flat to 220 openings; flips to 0 when Blink's fake mouse move runs), so a window of 40 openings measured +39 or +0 by chance; always-mounted dialogs are never removed, hence 0. Proof: with page.mouse.move(2,2) after each close, per-opening AlertDialog, per-opening Dialog and mounted-once all count 0 in every sample (16 openings x 2 runs each); a dialog whose effect adds a never-removed listener still fails (+1000 nodes, +320 listeners). Earlier hypotheses ruled out: Stack/useMediaQuery/autofocus (bisect), Chromium LCP/ICP/event/layout-shift/element timing (disabling them does not remove it; a first single-sample result looked like it did). Not an Astryx bug: no upstream note; if anything it is a Chromium behaviour (detached nodes retained by the mouse-hover target until the next mouse event). Rule (root AGENTS.md UI rules): mount a dialog once and open it with isOpen, or mount it per opening; both are fine; leaks.spec moves the pointer off after every close; a count that survives that is real; slack never raised. Change: leaks.spec cycle() moves the pointer; app/dev/dialog-leak fixture (dev only, not in the production build); cases: mounted once, mounted for each opening, dialog that keeps what it mounted (test.fail). Runs: pointer NOT moved -> per-opening AlertDialog +39 nodes/+7 listeners (fails), pointer moved -> 0/0 (passes); all 9 cases expected. Consequence for .13: the leave question may be mounted per opening (it was kept always-mounted because of this), which would also put it in the tree after a Radix modal opened (the aria-hidden gap on .12). Side finding: tests/prod/weight.spec.ts fails on feat/astryx e1f3eff: /flows 345.6 KB JS vs the 300 KB budget (the fixture is not in the production build: 0 files contain its strings).

comments.author: lead
comments.text: Measured evidence for Plan B (ph6, 2026-10-01, Next 16.3.8 production standalone, RSS of the Next process sampled every 100 ms, real app upload path XHR+FormData and curl; scripts in the lead's scratchpad/upload/): Next's rewrite proxy buffers the whole upload in its process: 58 MB +61 MB, 300 MiB +308 MB, 1 GiB +576 MB (fast upstream) and +1077 MB (slow upstream, 32 MB/s), 2 x 300 MiB at once +612 MB; memory is released late (+234 MB still held 8 s after one 300 MiB upload). Content-Length is preserved (equal to the bytes; no Transfer-Encoding, no Expect), so the backend's new 411 rule does not fire on real uploads. Above Next's 2 GiB limit there is NO 413: Next forwards the declared Content-Length but stops after ~2 GiB, the upstream waits, the client hangs until its own timeout (the backend's 1 GiB MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES on fix/backend-body-limits rejects such a declared length with 413 before reading). Next also drops a trailing slash when forwarding (/runtime-files/?x -> /runtime-files?x): the backend routes must tolerate it. Conclusion: removing the Next server removes ~1x file size of RAM per concurrent upload; until Plan B ships, size the container for concurrent uploads x largest file.

description:
## Read first
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-single-process-runtime-plan.md`: "Global Constraints", "What Plan B carries over", "Test profiles" and Task B4.2 (the 16-check table), rows 25, 26 and "Test profiles".

## Scope
Create `deploy/acceptance.sh`, `deploy/acceptance/compose.yml`, `deploy/acceptance/traefik.yml`, `deploy/acceptance/checks.py`. Modify `frontend/package.json` (`test:image`). The fake Eneo is `frontend/tests/e2e/stub-server.py` (B3.1) mounted into a python container: there is no second fake. The upload scripts of B0.1 are reused.

## Out of scope
- Changing the BFF's auth logic or the shape of its API (`/api/auth/*`, `/api/eneo/*`, `/api/live/*`, allowlist, session store); the plan's three deliberate narrowings (docs routes, slash twins and the slash tolerance) are the exceptions.
- Gate thresholds, gate states removed, axe exclusions, the Astryx versions (exact pins), ejecting ("swizzling") a component, authoring StyleX, adding Tailwind.
- Any file the task's Scope does not name. If something outside it looks wrong, write a comment on this bead (`br comments add`) and leave it alone.
- Plan C (the module kit).

## Steps
Follow the plan's Task B4.2: write the checks first and run them against `stt-before` (B0.1) to see which can fail; then run on the new image. The 16 checks: health; one process, no node/supervisord, non-root; deep links with no redirect; 404s with no HTML; headers; the `shipped` project of `test:prod` and the real profile's claim states plus the renewal tests for `phone-390-light`, against the image, with the sentinel; Range streaming (206, 416) and no leaked upstream; live socket limits naming the user (64 KiB passes, 128 KiB + 1 closes 1009); upload memory with `MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES` set above the encoded body so the 300 MiB and 1 GiB uploads must complete (the stub's stats show every byte) and rejection measured separately (over-cap is a 413, abandoned upload leaves no temp file); `docker stop` under 10 s; PDF framing; the speaker-review build arg; no dev pages in the default image; size/start/RSS/CPU and `page-cost.cjs` against B0.1; the live relay's round trip idle versus under 200 static clients (loaded p95 at most twice idle); the stub published on a host port as the image's `ENEO_PUBLIC_URL` so the browser can follow the sign-in handshake, and the same contracts through a Traefik in the acceptance stack, including a write naming no user being a 409.

## Acceptance Criteria
- All 16 checks pass on the new image; the tables of checks 14 and 15 and the answers of check 16 are in the pull request.
- Checks 14 and 15 show no regression against B0.1 / idle (otherwise stop and report).
- Upload RSS follows the spool, not the file size (baseline: +308 MB for 300 MiB on Next), and the 1 GiB upload completes.

## Verify
```bash
deploy/acceptance.sh
```

**14, against B0.1.** Image 209 MB (394). Recreate to healthy 5.9 s (5.45; first /health not timed). Idle RSS **56.7 MB** (Next + uvicorn 128.6; with supervisord 157.9). After 20 loads of `/flows` **52.0 MB** (196.5). 10 browsers polling, 4.97 polls/s: CPU **2.7 %** of a core (8.4), RSS max **53.4 MB** (201.3). First-load transfer, JS + CSS: `/flows` 248.8 + 29.4 KB (318.7 + 43.3, i.e. -23 %), `/flows/<id>` 327.3 + 35.2 KB (413.0 + 43.3, -21 %); requests 29 and 32 (34 and 29); LCP desktop 100/108 ms (144/192), throttled phone 2588/2924 ms (3024/3292); TBT 0..27 ms (0..123); CLS 0 on both desktop pages, 0.002 on `/flows` on the phone profile and 0 on the flow page (the D4 threshold I use is 0.01: the organisation's mark in the first frame shifts nothing measurable). LCP/TBT move with the machine's load; the sizes and counts do not.

**15, STOP CONDITION: "the live relay's p95 under static load is more than twice its idle p95".** As the plan words it, 200 clients fetching the page and its 13 assets with no cache, in a loop, for 30 s: idle p50/p95/p99 1.88/3.96/6.13 ms (150 round trips), loaded 13.03/**21.12**/29.65 ms at 2,780 requests/s and 290 Mbit/s: 5.3x. Measured from a container on the stack's own network (no host networking layer), 15 s runs: 10 clients (1,228 req/s) idle p95 2.4, loaded 10.8 ms (4.4x); 50 clients 52 ms (25x); 200 clients 64 ms (22x). The loop is the worst case: every client reloads at once with no pause, so the module's single event loop is saturated at about 1,250 to 3,400 requests/s. With the same 200 visitors each loading the page (14 requests, nothing cached) and then waiting, idle p95 about 2.5 ms:

| page loads/s | requests/s | relay p50 / p95 / p99 (ms) |
|---|---|---|
| 11.4 | 160 | 1.26 / 2.53 / 4.58 |
| 45.5 | 638 | 1.52 / 3.55 / 5.04 |
| 102.6 | 1,437 | 8.27 / 23.97 / 34.3 |
| 207.5 | 2,906 | 2.39 / 10.2 / 18.8 |
| 243.1 | 3,403 | 9.5 / 19.2 / 25.0 |

So the relay stays within 1.4x of idle up to about 45 first-time page loads per second (640 requests/s) and is 4 to 10x idle at 100 and above. For a municipality of hundreds to a few thousand users that is the difference between a normal day and the whole organisation opening the page in the same second; the absolute p95 under the worst load, 20 to 60 ms, is far inside a live caption's tolerance (20 frames a second, a word every 200 ms). The rule is the plan's and it fires; the plan says: serve the assets from a faster path or cache them at the edge before the first deployment, or the owner accepts it. Options for the lead/owner: (a) accept with the table above as the reason and set check 15's load to the accepted rate; (b) a lighter path for `/assets/*` (a bare ASGI handler in front of FastAPI's routing and middleware, which is most of the 0.8 ms a request costs on one core); (c) Traefik cache is not available (no plugin). The check stays as the plan words it and fails; I changed nothing in the module.

**16, through Traefik.** Passes: the login's state cookie and the session cookie arrive and come back; a write naming no user is 409 `user_changed`, through Traefik and direct; the socket upgrades and relays a 64 KiB frame and another Origin is refused (403); Range 206, 206 and 416 are the same as direct; a NUL path is the module's 404 JSON through Traefik too (it passes encoded characters as written: the `%2F`... warning in its log is not a refusal; my earlier note that it rejects them was wrong); 300 MiB and 1 GiB uploads complete, the stub gets every byte, memory +0..1 MB; `docker stop` with a stream open through Traefik 8.3 s. **Fails: an over-cap upload is not answered 413 every time.** 300 MiB sent in full against a cap of 100 MiB, curl, 100 attempts each: direct **97 x 413 and 3 connection errors** (reset or broken pipe), through Traefik **65 x 413 and 35 x 502**. The module (BodyLimitMiddleware) answers 413 with `Connection: close` as soon as the counted bytes pass the cap, while the client is still sending; behind the proxy that comes back as a 502 about a third of the time. The check sends 20 and requires 413 each time. For the lead: the B1 backend lane decides how the module should refuse (drain a bounded amount before closing, or keep the connection and discard) or whether 502 is acceptable to the UI; the page's upload error handling should be read against it (a user whose 3 GB file is refused sees a retry offer, not "too large", a third of the time).

**Method findings that changed the checks.** (1) Check 8 sent the oversize frame whole: the module closes with 1009 and then the connection resets with the frame's payload unread, and the close frame can be lost (1 run in 8 saw no code); it now sends the frame's header alone, which carries the length the server refuses on (15 of 15 read 1009). (2) Traefik does not pass a request on until the first body bytes arrive and even 256 KiB is not always enough, so a request that declares a length and sends no body waits forever through it: the declared-length probe of check 9 is direct only. (3) Check 9 read only the backend's memory, and the old image's cost was in Next: it passed on stt-before. It now sums every process, and fails there (+309 MB for 300 MiB).

**Proof that the checks can fail (step 1, run against `stt-before`).** Failing: 2 (processes), 4 (`/assets/x.js` and others answer HTML), 5 (the API answers carry none of the headers), 9 (+309 MB), 10 (`docker stop` over 10 s), 13 (no dist in the image). Holding on both images: 1, 3, 7, 8, 11. 14 and 15 compare against the baseline numbers and were not run against stt-before.

**Not verified.** Check 6's second half (the real profile's claim states, B3.2); check 12's marker survives a change of the review text (it is the ASCII start of the flag-only sentence); a run on a GitHub runner or on amd64; TLS and the Secure cookie (B6.1).

title: Capacity admission for uploads, file streams and live sockets (before sensitive use)
description: From the external review R03 (Codex stt-external-review pass 1, accepted). Today: byte limits per request and a total deadline only during the forward to Eneo. Multipart reception has no deadline (backend/app/main.py about :423 against :456), so slow senders can hold upload slots and temp disk indefinitely. File streams share the auth HTTP client with no admission (upstream.py about :87). Do it once, in the owner that ships: the kit's BFF (packages/bff), which Plan C adopts; the kit already has a stream cap of 64 and a bounded pool wait. Requirements: (1) uploads acquire capacity BEFORE multipart parsing and hold it through forwarding and cleanup; (2) a bounded reception time; (3) file streams counted in heavy-I/O admission; (4) temp storage sized against concurrent uploads × MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES; (5) live overload uses the existing retryable error contract the browser understands, not HTTP Retry-After alone. Proof: one bounded saturation test covering uploads, downloads, live and auth together; auth renewal must stay available. SKIP per-tenant quotas and a separate auth pool unless that test shows auth starving.

comments.author: lead
comments.text: Evidence from B4.2 check 9 (kit-perf, 2026-10-04): a client that goes silent mid-upload keeps the module reading, with its unlinked spool file (up to the upload size on disk) and the socket held open with no end. Uploads have no stall timeout of their own, and only the ingress's read timeout bounds it. This is requirement (2), bounded reception time. Add a per-upload inactivity deadline as well as the total, and test it with a client that stops sending.
